values.binNote: Wiki text states 20% but bin ThreshQ.SlowPercent = 75; this is a self-slow after Shackle, not the same 75% value in the bin, which is unused/unexplained by this text - discrepancy noted.

mechanics.claim: Thresh is unable to move or attack while the scythe is in flight.
mechanics.quote: becoming {{tip|lockout|unable}} to move or attack while it is in flight.

mechanics.claim: The scythe stuns and reveals the first enemy hit and applies a Shackled mark preventing Thresh from basic attacking for its duration.
mechanics.quote: The scythe catches the first enemy hit to deal {{as|magic damage}}, {{tip|stun}} and {{tip|true sight|reveal}} them for {{fd|1.5}} seconds

mechanics.claim: Thresh can recast Death Sentence as Deathly Leap to dash to the Shackled target, becoming able to attack again upon arrival.
mechanics.quote: '''Thresh''' stops tugging his hook and {{tip|dashes}} to the ''Shackled'' enemy, becoming able to attack again upon arrival.

mechanics.claim: Spell shield blocks all of Death Sentence's effects, including the mark and preventing the cooldown reduction.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Spell shield}} will block all of ''Death Sentence's'' effects, including the mark as well as prevent the cooldown reduction.

mechanics.claim: Death Sentence triggers on-cast effects like Spellblade once at cast start and once at cast end, possibly a third time on Deathly Leap recast.
mechanics.quote: ''Death Sentence'' triggers on-cast effects (such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive) once at the start of the cast, and once at the end of the cast.
